args.title: Tamarack warehouse automation articles — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse and its companion piece (https://insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion):

- Autonomous carts lifted warehouse pick rates by 18% in 2026.
- Integration of the automation took twice as long as planned.
- The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
